bundles.name: ia-stats
bundles.description: Automatic per-agent / per-skill usage tracker. Appends a row to AGENT_STATUS.MD on every event via a cross-platform Node.js script (stdlib only, no package.json required). Ships for both Claude Code (real event hooks) and GitHub Copilot (VS Code tasks).

bundles.name: mvn
bundles.description: Maven offload — /mvn <goals> dispatches a runner agent so build logs do not flood the parent context. Ships for both Claude Code (Haiku sub-agent) and GitHub Copilot (chat-mode agent).

bundles.name: npm
bundles.description: npm offload — /npm <args> dispatches a runner agent so Vitest / Vite / lint logs do not flood the parent context. Ships for both Claude Code (Haiku sub-agent) and GitHub Copilot (chat-mode agent).
